pages.text: Enhanced Celestials gives the moon moods. A chat line announces each one at dusk.$(br2)$(bold)Blood Moon:$() the undead come thick, and keep coming. Stay inside the wall.$(br)$(bold)Harvest Moon:$() crops give more.$(br)$(bold)Blue Moon:$() luck; fish and loot are kinder.$(br)$(bold)Super Moon:$() slimes.

Super variants of each are rarer and stronger. A $(bold)Super Blood Moon$() is a siege; have the guards ready and the dog inside.$(br2)Weather is seasonal too: winter storms snow, summer storms are short and loud.
